method.pagination: Actual data-pagination-next controls; no guessed page URL or query. URL and selected page recorded after each click.
method.language: Edge automatic page translation may render category/title/role labels in Chinese; visible label and exact link href are both retained.
method.unavailableFields: Card title and originalWorkUrl remain null when not present in the listing card DOM. Hidden tags are not opened or inferred; hiddenTagCount and visibleTags are retained.
method.association: Only exact full media URL equality with the existing AI Flow work-inventory.json read-only snapshot; duplicate cards are retained.
method.mediaEvidence: mediaUrl / posterUrl identify rendered DOM assets only and are not evidence that their animation was watched.
method.emptyAttributionHref: 8 cards have an actual empty href in the Post by attribution area. Their resolved a.href would equal the category URL, so attributionUrl remains null; attributionRawHref is preserved as the empty string and role text is recorded. All nonempty attribution links, including personal websites, are retained.
